reviews.text:
This is my first purchase of the Wakemake Stay Fixer Multi Color Powder in 02 Light Skin, and I have a good first impression of it.

The powder feels lightweight on the skin and helps to set my makeup without looking heavy or cakey. I like how the different colors blend together to brighten and even out my complexion while giving a natural finish.

It controls excess shine nicely and leaves my skin looking smooth and fresh throughout the day. The shade 02 Light Skin works well for my skin tone and doesn’t leave a white cast.

Overall, it looks great on the skin and performs well as a setting powder. I’m happy with this purchase and look forward to using it more.
reviews.zh:
呢個係我第一次買 Wakemake Stay Fixer Multi Color Powder 02 Light Skin，初印象幾好。

粉質上皮膚感覺輕盈，可以定妝又唔會顯厚或者一撻撻。我鍾意唔同顏色mix埋一齊，可以提亮均勻膚色，效果好自然。

控油效果都唔錯，皮膚成日都keep住滑溜同清爽。02 Light Skin 呢個色號幾適合我嘅膚色，唔會泛白。

整體嚟講，妝感好好，作為定妝粉表現唔錯。呢次買得好滿意，期待繼續用落去。

reviews.text: Each palette features 3 color-correcting shades tailored to balance different skin tones. It delivers long-lasting makeup setting while providing a soft-focus, brightening effect.
reviews.zh: 每個調色盤設有 3 個校色色號，專為平衡唔同膚色而設。定妝效果持久，同時帶有柔焦提亮嘅效果。

reviews.text: What an innovative power! I first bought this because I was curious about the blue, purple, and green color of the powder and how it would look on my skin. And it leaves a very natural finish. You would never know it was colored. I have oily skin and it works very well at oil control as well as smoothing out your makeup and leaving a matte finish.
reviews.zh: 呢款粉真係好有創意！我最初係因為對呢隻粉嘅藍、紫、綠色感興趣，好奇上咗皮膚會係點。結果出嚟個妝感好自然，完全睇唔出有顏色。我係油性肌，佢控油效果非常好，又可以令妝容更滑順，妝效係霧面嘅。

reviews.text: Such a thin powder which is perfect for not looking too cakey after applying. Has a slight sparkle which acts sort of like highlighter which is quite nice under the eyes. Soft subtle pink colour not over the top which is always a plus, very natural.
reviews.zh: 粉質好幼細，搽完一啲都唔厚。帶有少少閃粉，效果有啲似 highlight，搽喺眼底位置幾靚。粉色柔和唔誇張，呢點加分，效果好自然。

reviews.text:
思ったより粒子は細かくないです。
乾燥肌で、少し粉浮きするような気がしますが、夏場に試してみます。
reviews.zh:
粒子比想像中唔算好細。
我係乾性肌，感覺有少少浮粉，不過等夏天再試下先。

reviews.zh: 呢款定妝粉真係超正，價錢同質素都超值！用咗優惠券一啲都唔後悔，上皮膚滑溜，膚色又perfect。我買嘅係 n° 1，仲跟埋掃，等緊下次特價再去買多幾盒 n° 2，可能再買多一盒 n° 1！佢真係值得推薦。質地好，品質佳，好易上妝，粉質又唔會浪費，因為係 loose 粉，我比較鍾意用佢跟嗰支掃，掃毛都好軟。而且個妝感同某個超高級嘅 lux 品牌好似！我揀嘅顏色我好鍾意，100% 推薦 MMK1803 #oliveyoungaffeliate 尋日嘅妝我搽咗喺眼底、鼻翼兩側同面珠！我想要綠色同藍色呀！對唔住我嗰盒其實係 number 2

reviews.text: this powder is really blurring and lasts a long time even on my combination skin. i would recommend using the powder puff that comes with it over a brush if you want fuller coverage!
reviews.zh: 呢款粉嘅柔焦效果好好，就算我係混合性肌都keep到好長時間。想要更全面嘅遮瑕嘅話，建議用跟機嗰個粉撲多過用掃。

reviews.text: If I could give this six stars, I absolutely would! I’ve used setting powders from Chanel, Dior, Koh Gen Do, Hourglass, Westman Atelier, and Chantecaille - both compact and loose forms. Hourglass used to be my go-to for its fine texture and natural glow, but it didn’t control the oiliness on my T-zone beyond 4–5 hours, so I often had to blot with oil paper. But Wakemake is a total game changer. My makeup stays fresh, clean, and smooth for 9-10 hours straight. I actually stared at the mirror in disbelief when I got home from work—it looked untouched. This powder blends oil into a natural, radiant glow without making me look shiny or greasy. It’s clever, long-lasting, and simply fascinating. Love it!
reviews.zh: 如果可以俾六粒星我一定俾！我用過 Chanel、Dior、Koh Gen Do、Hourglass、Westman Atelier 同 Chantecaille 嘅定妝粉——無論係壓粉定係 loose 粉都試過。以前 Hourglass 係我最常用嘅，質地細緻，妝感自然帶光澤，但係 T 區控油撐唔到 4–5 個鐘，經常要吸油紙補救。不過 Wakemake 真係完全改變咗個局面。妝容可以keep住 fresh、乾淨、滑順足足 9 至 10 個鐘。收工返到屋企對住塊鏡睇，簡直唔敢相信——妝容完全無溶過。呢隻粉可以將油脂化成自然嘅光澤，但係又唔會令你成塊面油笠笠或者油光滿面。佢好 smart、好持久，真係令人驚艷。超愛！
